contract: v6 S1 transfer test, PREREGISTERED before the run. Path B phase-3 protocol unchanged (scripts/v6/measure_transfer_v6.py, a copy of scripts/pathB/measure_transfer.py from Path B 89bc3d9).
status_of_arm: S1-A3 parameters FROZEN as fitted. The A3 FIT IS REJECTED by its own spec (release cost 4.02 > 1.0; held-out 2 of 4: H1 pass, H3 pass, H2 fail, H4 fail). This run is therefore a DIAGNOSTIC of the best available input stage; it can falsify S1 but cannot turn the rejected fit into a calibrated v6. Recorded either way.
engine: BrainV6 = v4 primary graded policy (v4-optic-lobe-graded), CPU, plus the frozen per-type parameters; only R1-R6 carry v6 parameters in S1
stimulus: Path B conditions C0 sham, C1 full-field ON (encoder 10 -> 20), C2 full-field OFF (10 -> 0), C3 column ON seeds 0-2; encoder level x 0.01 = light in BG0 units (10 = BG-1)
readout: right eye, COMPLETE columns, group mean dV in window E (0-50 ms) and S (50-200 ms) versus the 100 ms baseline; resp = the window with the larger magnitude

predictions_from_reduced_model.note: reduced single-cell lamina model of the A3 fit (BG-1 -> 2x step, mean over the step); predicts L2 BELOW the 5 mV threshold

verdict_rule: PASS only if every pass criterion holds. S1 as a stage is FALSIFIED if any of Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 has |resp| < 0.5 mV. Also reported, no threshold: L3-L5, Mi4, Mi9, Tm4, Tm9, T4, T5, the OFF condition, the C3 column conditions.
compute: CPU, one numba thread, nice, taskset 0-3; no GPU
